summary: iter232 — Tested /grow page end-to-end. Backend /api/grow/traction passes all 7 pytest tests (schema, integer/non-negative invariants, cache identity, cache speed, makers_total >= founding_makers, roadmap_pct in range). Frontend /grow loads cleanly with 0 console errors, no compile overlay, all required sections render (hero CTAs, Momentum counters, 4-phase roadmap with DONE/IN PROGRESS/UPCOMING/FUTURE statuses, Founder Letter with Michael Williams + Williams CNC). All animated counter values match the live API payload (15, 84, 32, 33, 8, 0, 45%). Mobile (375px) shows 0px horizontal overflow.
critical_code_review_comments: GrowWithUs.jsx is a single 683-line file — consider splitting into Hero/Vision/Roadmap/Traction/FounderLetter sub-components for maintainability (file-size guideline >700 lines, currently just under).

grow_page.py: in-memory cache uses module-level dict. Acceptable for single-worker dev but will cause inconsistent counters under multi-worker uvicorn/gunicorn — counters could differ per worker for up to 60s after a write. Low priority; behavior is intentionally cached and never wrong, just potentially stale per-worker.

Frontend Traction component renders `founding_makers` (15) but not `makers_total` (18) — this is by design per the file (telling the founders story). If main agent intended to expose total makers, add another counter card. Otherwise no action.

grow_page.py: `_cache` dict typed as dict[str, object] — fine but assigning None as initial 'data' then truthy-checking `_cache["data"]` is mildly brittle. A `_cache['at']` sentinel of 0.0 already covers the cold path; consider `if _cache['data'] is not None and ...`.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all spec checks passed: route loads, 0 console errors, all sections render, counters match API, mobile no overflow)

test_credentials: n/a — public endpoint and public page, no auth required
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend route mounted at /api/grow/traction via routers/grow_page.py. Frontend route /grow registered in App.js with GrowWithUs.jsx. The page intentionally renders founding_makers (not makers_total) — verified by inspecting GrowWithUs.jsx line 499. API payload at test time: makers_total=18, founding_makers=15, products_listed=84, community_members=32, forum_threads=33, clips_published=0, showcase_posts=8, roadmap_pct=45. 60s in-memory cache verified via identity check + sub-2s second call. Mobile 375px tested clean (0px overflow). Test file path: /app/backend/tests/test_iter232_grow_traction.py.
